blocks.text: 6. The Commons and the Orison Chamber

Real-world analogue: A caravanserai, harbor exchange hall, covered market, public courtyard, and an old city rebuilt by many communities whose masonry never quite matches. Visible repairs are evidence of participation rather than design failure.
World relation: Strongly Open World, with Continuity practice preserving contributors and disagreements. It can also contain Crafted districts built through collaborative architecture.

Connection to newer locations: The Commons relates to the Monsoon Stepwell City, Urban Canyon Hive, City of Rainward Roofs, Last City of Many Forms, and Mosaic Worldscar. All depend on shared maintenance without requiring sameness.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: A public place is created by contributions no single party owns enough to erase. Its seams demonstrate that cooperation does not require the past to become unanimous.
